_doc: motion fragment: the three moments of motion that carry meaning. (1) act 02, the seven plates landing on the stack (12.5-15.5 s, cues act02:plate:1..7, weight 0.5 -> 1): a soft thud, quieter and higher for the light early plates, 6 dB per doubling of weight (plate 1 is 6 dB under plate 7) and 1.5 -> -1 semitones, plus a very quiet dry tick so the landing reads on small speakers. (2) act 07, the ten profile rows (80.0-83.77 s, act07:row:1..10): no rule since the final review. The score plays a crotale on every row, so each row keeps its onset; the soft pop layered on it read as masked under that crotale (qa audibility), a doubled event. (3) act 09, the three comets (cues act09:comet:1..3 at 106.0 / 106.5 / 107.0 s are the badge pops at the branch ends; each then climbs the branch 0.5-0.9 s later): a rising swoosh whose apex lands 0.8 s after the cue, near the fastest point of the climb, so the three swooshes arrive at 106.8 / 107.3 / 107.8 s just before the full chord at 108.0 s; panned to the branch (left, middle, right) and a touch louder each time. Unsounded on purpose: act03 hexagon / mark landings and act09 chord (impacts / music own those moments); the act08 sector landings were unsounded too until Task 7 (see (4), which reverses that choice). The act 04 module pings (act04:module:k) are voiced by the score's vibraphone and sounded by no rule here; no rule matches kind bell or veil. Levels are relative (Task 6 balances the buses): plates peak about -22 dBFS, comets -19..-20 (loudest channel). (4) Task 7 fix, act 08 (reverses the earlier 'sector landings unsounded' choice): the four sector landings (94.0, 96.25, 98.5, 100.77, cues act08:sector:1..4; 94.0 is the hard cut from the plugboard) had no sound, so four picture events had no new attack (earshot critique v4, major 2). Each now gets the plate recipe at whole-screen weight: thud -10 dB (9 dB over the plates' -19), tick -12 (17 dB over the plates' -29) and a bright click -17 (mo.click), jitter +-1.2 dB, pitch +-1 semitone on thud and tick. The same fix sounds three of the four whoosh events that had no rule (collapse, return, dark, in the transitions fragment); act02:vortex stays silent under the riser.

mo.thud._doc: Mixkit 1901 'Bed pillow hit the mattress': a soft low thud (centroid 400 Hz); the thump rises at 0.18-0.20 s after a faint rustle of the pillow in the air, so the trim starts at 0.155 (10 ms fade-in over the rustle) and ends at 0.45 s, before the pillow's second bounce at 0.49 s. HP 85 Hz (order 4): the raw body sits at 55 Hz, inaudible on a laptop.

mo.tick._doc: Mixkit 2070 'Light impact on the ground': a dry 20 ms knock (centroid 1.7 kHz) that gives the thud its contact; 0.12 s of the file, then silence.

mo.comet._doc: Mixkit 169 'Futuristic sweep pass by' (the only candidate whose spectrum really rises: centroid 2.8 -> 5.0 kHz over 0.1-0.55 s, level up 24 dB to the apex at 0.75 s). Trim 0.10-0.92 s: the rise and the apex, then the Doppler fall is cut in 0.12 s. Folded to mono: the file is a pass-by that sweeps across the stereo field by itself (one channel 20-30 dB under the other at the apex), which fought the pan toward each branch; the comet is a point climbing a branch, so the rule's pan places it.

mo.click._doc: Task 7 fix. Mixkit 1116 'Single classic click' (0.10-0.23 s, LP 8 kHz): the bright edge of a whole-screen sector landing. The onset detector of earshot's critique reads a broadband transient, not a soft thud, as a new attack; layered 7 dB under the thud (-17 against -10).
